scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Mei’s confirmed Saturday heritage memory-table seat usable by getting its required printed name-card line into the batch before production.
Emerging Need: The table role is uncertain at first; once family consent and roster confirmation align, the future seat still lacks a prerequisite card entry.
Decision Context: A contact card gives the only mailbox that feeds the print batch, while a saved placard note supplies the approved public wording and privacy boundary.
Consequence: Timely completion lets the organizer print the assigned card; after the batch locks, blank entries move to guest seating and the prevention value is gone.

parameter.title: Mei heritage memory table
parameter.description: Potential Rose City Heritage Circle memory-table visit; table role pending roster confirmation.
parameter.location: Rose City Heritage Hall, Portland, OR

parameter.name: Rose City Heritage Circle Desk
parameter.notes: Participant-info mailbox is the source for printed storyteller name cards; phone desk can answer logistics but cannot edit the card batch.

parameter.content: I checked with Mei. If the heritage circle has a real memory-table seat for her, she is okay being named only with the short public placard wording Nora saved, and no other family or support details. If the seat is not confirmed, please do not send anything.

parameter.subject: Heritage Circle card-batch status for Saturday
parameter.body: Automated roster status: Mei Bexley is confirmed for the 3/21 storyteller memory table. The name-card field for her assigned seat remains blank. The 3:30 PM card batch pulls only entries received through the participant-info mailbox on the current contact card; blank entries become guest chairs for Saturday.

parameter.subject: Heritage Circle card batch locked
parameter.body: The 3:30 PM card batch is locked. Assigned memory-table seats with blank name-card fields, including Mei Bexley's, have been converted to unbadged guest seating for Saturday; late text can be retained only for a future circle.
